posts.caption: Celebrating our brilliant champions! Extraordinary performance in JEE Advanced and NEET-UG. Hard work, daily error analysis, and supreme dedication always bear fruit. Proud of every single scholar at Balaji and Yashoda Bhavans! #OxfordVIT #IITJEE #NEET #Narasaraopet #Champions

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: Mathematics is not about memorizing steps; it is about cultivating intuition. In our Super-60 classes at Balaji Bhavan, every problem is a gateway to deeper geometric and algebraic insight. 100 days to JEE Main — focus on error logs every single evening. #IITJEE #Mathematics #Super60
posts.mediaDescription: Conceptual chalkboard proof and problem breakdown on coordinate geometry locus transformations taught in Super-60 evening class.
posts.achievementDetails: Pedagogical insight behind consecutive years of 99.8+ percentile in JEE Main Mathematics.
posts.verificationStatus: Verified - Verified Management Profile (@raghava_vit on Threads)

posts.caption: State 1st Marks in BIEAP Board Examinations! 992/1000 and 467/470. Our holistic blueprint ensures board security while competing for national top ranks. Gratitude to our dedicated lecturers and proud parents. #BIEAP #OxfordVIT #StateTopper #Narasaraopet

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: Discipline in residential life is what converts potential into national achievement. At Yashoda Bhavan, safety, peace, and uninterrupted study hours give our girl scholars the confidence to conquer AIIMS and top medical colleges. 24/7 security with parental warmth. #GirlsEducation #ResidentialCampus
posts.mediaDescription: Institutional briefing discussing security protocols, female warden supervision, quiet study alcoves, and evening revision cycles.
posts.campus: Yashoda Bhavan & Vasavi Tower Girls Campus
posts.achievementDetails: Over 500+ successful MBBS admissions from Oxford VIT medical division.

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: On Gandhi Jayanti, Oxford VIT family dedicated ourselves to community service. KSR Charitable Trust sponsored health checkups and eye screening camps for 1,200+ villagers in Palnadu. True education extends far beyond classrooms. #KSRTrust #CommunityService #Narasaraopet #Healthcare
posts.mediaDescription: Photograph of Administrative Director K. Srinivasa Rao (KSR) and volunteer student squads assisting visiting ophthalmologists and distributing free eyeglasses to rural elders.
posts.event: Annual KSR Trust Rural Health Camp & Blood Donation Drive
posts.achievementDetails: Free eye-care screening for 1,200+ rural elders and ₹15 Lakhs in surgical support mobilized.
posts.verificationStatus: Verified - Registered Public Charitable Trust Records & Social Post

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: National Science Day at Raman Bhavan! Over 60 live working models presented by our innovative intermediate and foundation scholars. From electromagnetism to genetic sequencing principles, the spirit of inquiry is alive at Oxford VIT! #NationalScienceDay #RamanBhavan #STEM
posts.mediaDescription: Student scientists demonstrating a working Tesla coil and automated hydro-plant model to visiting dignitaries and parents at Raman Bhavan exhibition quadrangle.
posts.event: National Science Day STEM Research Exhibition
posts.achievementDetails: 5 student science models shortlisted for state-level young innovators competition.

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: Tricolor flying high across all Oxford VIT campuses in Narasaraopet, Guntur, and Bapatla. Independence Day is a reminder that disciplined youth build a powerful India. Salutes to our martyrs and our dedicated teachers shaping the next generation. #IndependenceDay #JaiHind

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: Faculty Orientation and Curriculum Alignment Conclave at KSR Towers. Led by DSR Sir (Ex-SRA IIT Delhi), P.V. Ranga Rao Sir, and our senior lecturers. Harmonizing pedagogy between board syllabus and JEE Advanced items. When teachers keep learning, students soar! #FacultyDevelopment #IITJEE

posts.achievementDetails: Pedagogical alignment of 45+ senior faculty members across Narasaraopet and Guntur centers.

posts.author: Panadi Raghava
posts.caption: Financial hardship should never extinguish an ambitious mind. Through KSR Charitable Trust, we distributed full tuition and residential scholarships to 150 rural students today at Arundelpet. Every child in Palnadu deserves the opportunity to become a doctor or an engineer. #KSRCharitableTrust #EducationForAll
posts.mediaDescription: Distribution of scholarship sanction letters, textbook kits, and uniforms to rural intermediate aspirants in the presence of community elders and trust trustees.
posts.event: KSR Charitable Trust Annual Scholarship Convocation
posts.achievementDetails: ₹1.5+ Crores annual educational assistance allocated for Intermediate and EAPCET coaching.
